{{Top}}
{{Quote|This contraption is a pair of folding wings and an integrated repulsorlift engine attached to a harness, which you steer with your body movements.|Chentu Chek|<ref name="BHC">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Parawing.jpg|thumb|200px]]
'''Parawings''' were an invention from the [[Tech (Imperial Intelligence)|Tech Section]] of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]. They were based on [[racing wings]] used by garbage pit racers. It was thought they could be used by [[TIE pilot]]s when they had to eject in a planetary atmosphere. They folded up against the spine of the wearer and could be deployed at the press of a button.

[[Jahan Cross]] took a set of parawings from [[Royd Pew]] before his mission to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 1|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 1]]</ref> Cross later used them to escape from a collision with a [[Hovertrain/Legends|mag-lev train]].<ref name="Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3">[[Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse 3|''Agent of the Empire – Iron Eclipse'' 3]]</ref>
